detailed_descriptions.en: Switch up the look of the TMNT heroes with the new Samurai Armor Pack! This pack comes with beautifully rendered outfits inspired by the Samurai armor the Turtles wear when going back in time to the Edo period. Strike fear into the Foot Clan with this elaborate armor tailored to each character’s personality. The Samurai Armor Pack includes exclusive outfits for the following playable characters: - Leonardo - Michelangelo - Raphael - Donatello - Casey Jones (requires Casey Jones & the Junkyard Jam DLC) - Metalhead (requires Metalhead Character DLC) - Alopex (requires Alopex Character DLC) - Slash (requires Slash Character DLC) Equip this armor from the Character Select screen when choosing your character, and find the warrior within!

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Switch up the look of the TMNT heroes with the new Samurai Armor Pack! This pack comes with beautifully rendered outfits inspired by the Samurai armor the Turtles wear when going back in time to the Edo period. Strike fear into the Foot Clan with this elaborate armor tailored to each character’s personality.

The Samurai Armor Pack includes exclusive outfits for the following playable characters:

- Leonardo

- Michelangelo

- Raphael

- Donatello

- Casey Jones (requires Casey Jones & the Junkyard Jam DLC)

- Metalhead (requires Metalhead Character DLC)

- Alopex (requires Alopex Character DLC)

- Slash (requires Slash Character DLC)

Equip this armor from the Character Select screen when choosing your character, and find the warrior within!
